status: FROZEN before any MPE-01 signal count or outcome
nature: execution-cost hypothesis on the frozen X2 signal (original8); NOT a new independent alpha; does not rewrite X2-WIDE FAILED; research only; no engine/runtime/UI/key/account change; all results exploratory

signal.built_from: canonical 1h -> complete UTC 4h bins; D01 PIT liquidity at the decision's last 1h bar

execution_data.coverage: 2024-10-11 17:00 .. 2026-09-27 23:45 UTC, 68764 contiguous 15m bars per coin, 0 gaps/dups
execution_data.vs_canonical_1h: 17191 hours per coin compared: opens all equal; H/L/C/volume equal except the same 4 hours on all 9 coins (2024-10-28 20:00, 21:00; 2025-01-14 13:00, 15:00 UTC) where Binance's own 15m and 1h klines disagree; kept as-is, lots touching them counted ('anomaly_hour_lots'); see data_quality.json

window.split: 2025-10-01 UTC on entry time; both halves consumedDEV; no sealed holdout

maker_arm.limit: signal 4h close -0.25 ATR4h (long, floor tick) / +0.25 ATR4h (short, ceil tick)
maker_arm.postonly: reject if the post bar OPEN is at/through the limit
maker_arm.work: 4 x 15m bars from post, then expire (60 min)
maker_arm.fill: trade THROUGH limit by >= 2 ticks AND bar base volume >= 100 x qty; touch never fills; fill at limit, no slippage
maker_arm.fill_bar: stop may hit (exit at stop at bar close); no partial/target/breakeven in the fill bar
maker_arm.slot: a working order reserves the max-1 slot until fill or expiry; post-only reject or refusal tries the next tie candidate; an unfilled order does not

taker_control: market at the post-bar OPEN + 2 bp slip; same clock, dist, sizing, exits; entry bar managed normally (X2 convention)
exits: unchanged X2: stop 2.5 ATR4h from entry fill, half at +1R (floor step, min checks), BE from the next management bar, 3R target, time cap first bar close >= post + 120 h; adverse open beyond stop -> exit at open

costs_assumptions.maker_base: entry 2 bp fee + 2 bp cash queue/adverse-selection penalty; exits 5 bp fee + 2 bp slip
costs_assumptions.taker_base: entry and exits 5 bp fee + 2 bp slip
costs_assumptions.stress: +8 / +16 bp fee on EVERY executed side
costs_assumptions.alltaker: maker fills charged 5 bp taker fee + 2 bp penalty
costs_assumptions.funding: stress proxy 1 bp/8h on qty x every held 15m close (1 bp/32 per bar) incl. fill and exit bars, cost on both sides

portfolio.filters: current testnet snapshot (step, min_qty, min_notional, tick)
portfolio.terminal_open: marked at last 15m close with exit costs, excluded from closes

readout.primary: m15 path, base costs, 40-order medians: maker vs taker meanR, closes, early/later, fill rate; plus portfolio-free signal-level table (taker R on maker filled / unfilled / rejected signals = adverse-selection check)
readout.gates: none for promotion: all exploratory. Any positive needs independent execution/data checks and actual bounded testnet maker-fill/protection evidence before ANY account-4 activation. X2-WIDE-style gate booleans are not computed.
readout.no_search: no side, coin, offset, latency, expiry, volume-multiple or tick search

tests: research/mpe01/test_run_mpe01.py (17 hostile tests; 11 key-line mutants all killed (3 needed added regression tests))
limitations: 15m OHLCV has no order book/queue; 2-tick-through + 100x volume is a proxy, not a fill guarantee
